conditional_diagnostic.scope: Standard linear inverse-problem and two-channel matrix controls only, not a native Donley reduction or new physical model.
conditional_diagnostic.criterion: For calibrated effects y=A*r and target a^T*r on an admissible difference space, identify the target iff ker(A) is annihilated by a^T. On the full Bloch ball this is equivalent to a^T in rowspace(A). Append genuinely known population rows. Full tomography is not mandatory.
conditional_diagnostic.orientation: Hold native coupling g fixed. The physical flux is proportional to Im(g*C); simultaneous C/g basis rephasing is coordinates, not a current obstruction. An unknown analyzer phase relative to fixed g can obstruct inference.
conditional_diagnostic.error: If A^T*beta=a, target=beta^T*y and variance=beta^T*Sigma*beta. Holdout residual includes train/holdout cross-covariance; calibration and higher-order remainder bounds remain additional inputs. Covariance alone is not a guaranteed error interval.
conditional_diagnostic.boundary: A conditional algebra failure cannot prove that the actual native protocol is impossible; a hypothetical ideal-y measurement cannot certify that it exists in this experiment.

single_missing_input.content: Source-native effects for the complete pulse2/expansion/release/detector chain, tied to the current-coupling phase and a specified preparation; continuum/loss/population contamination, joint calibration/covariance and higher-order error bounds; separate unused-for-fitting outcome counts in a valid finite-time window.
single_missing_input.reentry: An actual packet with changed source/evidence hash or a precise source/math error. No equivalent Rabi analogy, phase fitting of the same curve, uncontrolled two-channel truncation or automatic successor.

verification: Primary and independently derived exact algebra/provenance checks plus separate hostile source/inference review. One gate-level synthesis. No new Lean theorem: source/instrument insufficiency is not a missing algebra lemma; existing EXCH Lean sources remain unchanged.
non_claims: No empirical holdout success, source-native impossibility, exact fixed-number preparation, EXCH quantization, full P1 identity, damping or time-law change, new model/state, PreA, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum or TOE.
